Further alteration of any kind or change in the use of the land must cease until a valid Zoning Permit has been obtained. Further alteration or change is punishable under the Franklin Township Zoning Code. The Zoning Code states that the Zoning Inspector, Prosecuting Attorney or the owner of any neighboring property who would be damaged by such violation may bring action against the violator. The Ohio Revised Code (505.75) gives Franklin Township the right to act upon these violations. The local court, upon conviction, has the right to fine violators not more than $100 per day, per violation, for each day the violation continues.
